_doc: Manufacturing Equipment & Factory — turnkey lines, assembly, laser. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

wuxi lead.one_liner: World's largest battery-manufacturing equipment maker (turnkey lines).

trumpf.one_liner: German laser leader; welding/cutting for cell & pack assembly.

siemens.one_liner: German industrial technology group; factory automation for battery manufacturing lines.

bühler group.one_liner: Swiss group supplying wet- and dry-coating equipment for electrode production.

schuler group.one_liner: German press-forming and stamping equipment maker used in cell-casing manufacture.

hitachi high-tech.one_liner: Japanese maker of battery-manufacturing and inspection equipment; part of Hitachi.

rockwell automation.one_liner: US industrial automation and control systems supplier to battery gigafactories.

kuka.one_liner: German industrial robotics maker used in cell/pack assembly lines; majority-owned by China's Midea Group.

yaskawa.one_liner: Japanese robotics and motion-control maker used in battery manufacturing.

fanuc.one_liner: Japanese factory-automation and robotics maker used in battery production lines.

ats automation.one_liner: Canadian automation systems integrator, including battery-manufacturing lines.

durr group.one_liner: German group supplying coating, cleaning and battery-production equipment.
